title: 期末考練習・第 3 週
focus: Unit 3 故事句、不可數、寫問句、oi/oy；Unit 4 先試試

items.text: I'm {{done}}. It {{smells}} so good.
No, thank you. My plate is {{full}}.
I'm so {{hungry}}.　Me too. I could eat a {{horse}}.

sections.title: 抄寫句子（課本）
items: I'd like a sandwich, please. Sure! Here you are.

sections.title: 這句是什麼意思？（考試有英翻中）

items.text: I could eat a horse. → {{我好餓。}}
My plate is full. → {{我的盤子滿了。}}

sections.title: 英文數字
sections.note: Unit 4 還沒教：會的就寫，不會的空著，不要查。

items.text: 12 → {{twelve}}　　15 → {{fifteen}}
20 → {{twenty}}　　30 → {{thirty}}

sections.title: 錯字複習
sections.note: 上週寫錯的字。看一次、蓋起來、寫兩次。

sections.title: 圈出正確的（課本 Learn with Boka）
sections.note: 照課本：coffee、ice cream、milk、tea 跟 some 用時不加 s。

items.text: I'd like some ( coffee / coffees ).
Would you like some ( ice cream / ice creams )?
一整個：I'd like ( a / some ) pizza.
一兩片：I'd like ( a / some ) pizza.
一個：I'd like ( a / some ) sandwich, please.

sections.title: 看回答，寫問句
sections.note: 考試題型。第 1 題問對方想吃什麼，第 2 題用 Would you like 開頭。問句句尾要有問號。

items.text: A: {{What would you like to eat?}}
B: I'd like some noodles, please.
A: {{Would you like some soup?}}
B: Yes, please.

sections.title: 上週以前的字（只看中文）
時間
sections.note: Unit 4 還沒教：會的就寫，不會的空著，不要查。

items.text: 6:00 → {{six o'clock}}　　7:30 → {{seven thirty}}

sections.title: 填 oi 或 oy（課本 Phonics）
圈出正確的字（易混字）
sections.note: coin 硬幣、corn 玉米、boy 男孩、bay 海灣。

items.text: There is a ( coin / corn ) in the soil.
The ( bay / boy ) is playing with a toy.
The ( coin / corn ) is fresh.

sections.title: 上週的披薩步驟（只看中文填）
sections.note: 照課文的用字和順序，連接詞和動詞都要寫。

items.text: {{First}}, {{slice}} the tomatoes.
{{Next}}, {{spread}} some tomato sauce on the dough.
{{Then}}, {{add}} cheese, tomato slices, and basil on top.
{{Lastly}}, {{bake}} the pizza in the oven.

sections.title: 這是什麼？寫英文
sections.note: Unit 4 還沒教：會的就寫，不會的空著，不要查。

items.text: ⏰ 起床 {{get up}}　　🛏️ 上床睡覺 {{go to bed}}
🍳 吃早餐 {{have breakfast}}　　🏫 上學 {{go to school}}

sections.title: 錯字複習：把句子排好
sections.note: 動詞 spread 要緊接在 Next, 後面。

items.ans: Next, spread some tomato sauce on the dough.

sections.title: 選字填空（他校考卷題型）

items.text: Look {{at}} the tomatoes. They're red now.
B and C: {{We'd}} like some rice.
I'm so hungry. I could eat a {{horse}}.
I'd like some steak, please.　Sure! {{Here you are}}.

sections.title: 把句子排好，寫在格子裡
sections.note: 句首大寫，逗號、句點、問號都要寫。

items.ans: Would you like some French fries?

sections.title: 看圖寫完整的回答
sections.note: 像課本一樣，兩樣東西用 and 連起來。

items.text: What would you like to eat?
{{I'd like some French fries and dumplings, please.}}

sections.title: 數字和時間
sections.note: Unit 4 還沒教：會的就寫，不會的空著，不要查。

items.text: 40 → {{forty}}　　50 → {{fifty}}
6:45 → {{six forty-five}}　　7:15 → {{seven fifteen}}

sections.title: 錯字複習（看中文和第一個字母）
本週小考：看中文寫英文
寫問句或完整的回答
sections.note: 問句要有問號；回答句尾要有句點。

items.text: A: {{What would you like to eat?}}　B: I'd like some pizza, please.
A: Would you like some milk?　B: {{No, thank you.}}
A: What would Amy like to eat?　B: {{She'd like some noodles.}}

sections.title: 時間和作息
sections.note: 還沒教，不算分，不用訂正。

items.text: 8:30 → {{eight thirty}}　　回家 {{go home}}　　吃晚餐 {{have dinner}}

sections.title: 對完答案：挑最多 3 個錯字，各蓋住重寫一次
sections.note: 先照解答一個字母一個字母對好，再寫。
